name: Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
November 30, 2018
  2:00 P.M.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  LAW ENFORCEMENT SERVICES SPECIAL TAX OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE
  OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request
a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee welcomes and encourages public
participation at the Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee meetings;
however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make
a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Chairperson. Anyone
wishing to address the Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee is requested to
fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the City
to identify persons for purposes of Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee
minutes preparation.

The Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee, at the direction of the
Chairperson with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the
agenda.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL (2:00 PM)

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

Law Enforcement Services Special Tax Oversight Committee Agenda
November 30, 2018

  Page 1 of 2
 COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items that are NOT
on the agenda. According to state law, no action can be taken by the Law Enforcement
Services Special Tax Oversight Committee on matters presented under this section.

NEW BUSINESS

1. Discussion of the Palos Verdes Estates Police Department’s FY 18-19 year to date budget
  expenditure report

  Recommendation: It is recommended the Law Enforcement Services Special Tax
  Oversight Committee receive and file the FY 18-19 year to date budget expenditure
  report.

2. Discussion of projected property tax revenue through December 2018 pursuant to Measure E

  Recommendation: It is recommended the Law Enforcement Services Special Tax
  Oversight Committee receive and file the projected property tax revenue through
  December 2018 pursuant to Measure E.

3. Consideration to verify that projected property taxes collected through Measure E were spent on
  Palos Verdes Estates Police Department expenditures

  Recommendation: It is recommended the Law Enforcement Services Special Tax
  Oversight Committee verify that projected property taxes collected through Measure E
  were spent on Palos Verdes Estates Police Department expenditures.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATION

The following items of correspondence are submitted to the Law Enforcement Services
Special Tax Oversight Committee for information.

  i. None

ATTACHMENTS

  a. Palos Verdes Estates Police Department FY 18-19 year to date budget expenditures
  b. Projected Property tax revenue through December 2018

The foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside
adjacent to Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA
90274, Palos Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2.
